authority: Research only; no monitoring, promotion, funding or broker action.
question: Does an explicit tight-range -> confirmed-breakout -> dynamic-trailing-exit lifecycle identify GLD's regime breakouts early, hold them through noise, and exit near overheat using a drawdown-from-recent-high take profit?
operator_direction: GLD first; all behavioral thresholds fitted. The earlier arbitrary log(1.25) range limit, 8-close confirmation, 5-session progress exit and tight ATR stop are replaced by fitted choices.

data.source: Pinned published audited GLD continuous history reused from the frozen range-breakout v2 study input and hash-verified against its manifest.
data.basis: Adjusted OHLC for signal/returns; audited raw volume for traded activity. Adjusted and raw GLD closes are identical. No filling, splicing or online prices.

chronology.rule: Fit and selection read only sessions through fit_end. OOS metrics start at the first session on/after oos_start and continue the same account and state.

structural_choices.execution: next session open; one whole-session delay in stress cases
structural_choices.accounting: fractional units, 100% target, zero cash yield, cost per side

objective.utility: 45% clipped scaled excess CAGR, 40% clipped excess Sharpe, 15% clipped excess regularized Calmar versus a matched-cost buy-and-hold of the same window; CAGR scaled by 10pp and clipped to +/-3; Sharpe/Calmar clipped to +/-3.
objective.robust: 0.5*full utility + 0.5*median of three contiguous IS block utilities - 0.25*std(blocks)
objective.note: The objective contains no post-2022 observation.

search.screening: 5bp per side, next-open fills, IS window only

selection.final_score: minimum fitness over the friction set
selection.evidence: >=10 closed IS episodes, average IS exposure >=20% at 5bp and at least one closed episode in each of the three contiguous IS blocks
selection.guards: at every friction: IS CAGR >= matched buy-hold CAGR - 2pp and IS maximum drawdown no worse than matched buy-hold drawdown - 5pp
selection.stability: Among evidence/guard-passing finalists within 0.05 of the best final_score, compute the fraction of +/-1-selection-step parameter neighbours whose IS fitness is within 0.15 of the candidate; choose the highest, then lower annual turnover, then higher exposure, then lexicographic parameters.
selection.fallback: If no candidate passes the guards the best evidence candidate is retained and marked descriptive.
selection.seal: selection.json is written and hashed before any 2023+ evaluation.

validation.purpose: Second pre-2023 chronology: fit 2005-2015, select, then evaluate 2016-2022. Untouched pseudo-OOS for the procedure; never reads 2023+.

limitations: The 2023+ interval has already been inspected in earlier GLD work and in the operator's review; it is a chronological development retest, not an untouched holdout.

The lifecycle structure was motivated by the operator's critique of the earlier attempt (confirmation lag, tight stop, five-session exit). Structure choices were not selected using post-2022 performance, but 2023 is not unbiased evidence for them.
A fitted rule can overfit 2005-2022 gold; block stability, friction stress, parameter-neighbour stability and a 2016-2022 pseudo-OOS validation are reported.
One US-listed gold ETF on a current-vintage provider history; no historical universe or publication-vintage certification. Cash earns zero; close-based stops can gap.
